    Gate
    One rejection rule in a source's gate chain.

    PoseObservation
    One robot-pose measurement from one source, before any gating.

    What produced an observation.

    One robot-pose source: a device, its own gate chain, and its own trust model.

    Gate outcome for one observation.
    PoseSourceInputs
    Everything a pose source reported since the last loop, as an AdvantageKit input.
    PoseSourceIO
    Hardware layer for one pose source, AdvantageKit style.
    StdDevModel
    Chooses how much the estimator should trust an observation that has passed every gate.
    StdDevModel.StdDevs
    Standard deviations handed to the pose estimator.

    Ring buffer of chassis yaw-rate samples, for the lookback spin gate.
